name: agent-autoloop
tagline: A lightweight automation middle‑platform for command‑line AI agents
description: Agent Autoloop is an open‑source tool that runs on Windows, macOS or Linux. It lets you schedule events, route them to command‑line agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and receive notifications via desktop, Feishu, Slack, Discord and other channels. The system works without external servers, using a plug‑in architecture for event sources, agents and delivery methods. It is aimed at developers who want their CLI agents to operate unattended and handle tasks like daily reports, issue triage or alert investigation.
best_for: sending notifications to Slack, Feishu, Discord, etc.
